segments.an7.25:1.2: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha … pe … katame ca, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
segments.an7.25:1.4: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū saddhā bhavissanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
segments.an7.25:2.1: “Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū hirimanto [hirīmā (sī.), hirimanā (dī. ni.2.138)] bhavissanti … pe … ottappino [ottāpīno (sī.)] bhavissanti … bahussutā bhavissanti … āraddhavīriyā bhavissanti … satimanto bhavissanti … paññavanto bhavissanti;
segments.an7.25:2.6: vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
segments.an7.25:3.1: “Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī”ti.
